nom: La Roche-Posay Anthelios Clear Skin Dry Touch Face Sunscreen SPF 60

avis.texte: most sunscreens feel way too greasy and make me break out. since I switched to this spf my skin is much more calm and less acne. makes my skin feel like velvet. before applying makeup let this sunscreen soak in for about 20mins and there isn't interference with makeup. I will be repurchase forever!!!

This is the best sunscreen ever! I have super oily and acne prone skin. This has never broken me out or caused my face to be excessively shiny. There is also almost no white cast! 100% would repurchase!
The white cast is minimal, but it feels like crazy. My skin was also very shiny/oily after a couple of hours.

This just doesn't work if you have fair or sun-sensitive skin. Sure it feels light weight and doesn't break me out, but I was applying this like every hour and still kept getting burnt. Not worth it..

I have extremely oily skin & tried dffrent suncreens, but this one has been the best for my skim, its not thick so if you wear make up it helps. It has a matte finish that helps reduce shine lightweight and comfortable for daily wear

avis.titre: Best protection under makeup I've found
avis.texte: I've always had issues with sunscreen under my foundation, it makes it really difficult to wear it and then layer products. This one is the exception! This dries down without any greasy residue and does not affect my foundation! I actually tried it on one side of my face, leaving the other without, with three different foundations and all foundations wore the same on both sides by the end of the day. It's incredible as a primer, exactly what I was looking for. It also has no scent, which is rare for sunscreen. No white cast. Just absorbs and protects without affecting makeup somehow. Amazing.

I have combo skin. This sunscreen does the job with sun protection I would say, but I don't like how incredibly drying it was for me. It accentuated my crow's feet. Like the title says, they're not kidding about how it's dry touch!!! I found this sunscreen to be incredibly drying for my skin and the worsttt when you sweat. I have not worn this while swimming yet. When sweating, the sunscreen just slides around and gets on your hands/arms when you wipe the sweat off your face which is annoying. I wonder if this is any better for people with oily skin... I did not experience pilling since I followed the advice of some of the other reviewers by putting on moisturizer and THEN this sunscreen after.

I thought this would be a safe sunscreen since it's chemical filters, but the automatic grey cast this gives me guarantees that I can only wear this underneath makeup. Other than that, it's a pretty good sunscreen doesn't run into the eyes or cause irritation.
Good sunscreen. Goes on smooth, but a little goes a long way. It does make my skin feel a little oily but it's not too bad. Works well under foundation.
It dried to a white cast, leaving behind a terrible residue. The sunscreen peeled and crumbled on my face and neck.
Wanted to love it but it pulls off my face. I use water based moisturizers like First aid beauty and Youth the people and this sunscreen doesn't mix well.

I am medium brown skin African American and unfortunately this product produce a white cast on my face. Also when applied on top of moisturizer the sun screen becomes grainy after a few hours. I love the brand but disappointed in this product.

avis.titre: Good Sunscreen But Leaves White Cast
avis.texte: I'm very dark skinned so I'm used to mineral sunscreens leaving a white cast but this is a chemical sunscreen so it should theoretically leave no cast. However no matter how much I rub it in, it leaves a cast and white streaks on my face and baby hairs.
I usually dont leave reviews but i hated it. It leaves a white cast and it peels when applying left me looking crusty once it dried 😒

I ride my bike several times a week for 70 minutes each ride and garden for hours at a time. The sun is shining and lovely, but my skin has really suffered because my other sunblock just wasn't enough. I found this product in best reviews and really love the protection it provides. When applied, my skin absorbs the sunscreen, but you can see there is a lotion on your face. I would not wear this as an everyday sunscreen for this reason, but definitely appreciate the coverage and protection it provides for my intense outdoor activities.

avis.titre: Leaves White Cast on Brown Skin
avis.texte: Not suitable for brown skin. At first application I looked a little pale. The worst was stepping into the sunlight and being told I had a white film on my face. I checked on my phone camera and I immediately washed this off. The search for a noncomedogenic mineral sunscreen for brown skin continues. I might try the tinted one next, hopefully the undertones suit me.

The best sunscreen for my face I've ever used hands down! I suffer from acne prone skin and this sunscreen has not caused me any breakouts. Dries with a matte finish..doesn't get shiny throughout the day. Would highly recommend!!

Wanted to love SO bad bc I use their face lotion and love- but honestly the worst sunscreen I've ever used. It starts to peel QUICKLY and it broke me out on my cheek area. My skin personally rejected it so nay for me

I dont reccoment this for my brown girls. It said try touch so bought with my oily skin in mind. The sunscreen left a chalky white cast on my face and when I rubbed my eye maybe 20 minutes later it started to peel off. Love la roche posay just not this product.
I love the matte finish of this sunscreen but it's soooo tricky to apply. It dries so fast and immediately starts pilling. It also builds up in my eyebrows and hairline which is pretty annoying.
Kinda of drying..but doesn't leave a white cast so that's good.
Terrible, it instantly balled up on my skin upon application. Not sure how it could soak into the skin with that kind of application/texture. Will try to return

avis.titre: I like it, it's almost perfect
avis.texte: I really like it. When I use this my pores look smaller and they pretty much disappear. My face stays matte all day. I have oily, aging, 50 yr old skin. It is a little tricky to apply. I use small amounts in each section and blend it well or you can end up with white streaks. It leaves me a little whiter but I dust a little face powder over it. I am pale to medium olive tone depending on the time a year. It smells like a chemical sunscreen but the smell disappears quickly. I use it anytime I don't want a greasy sunscreen face.
Works well enough alone but when used over other products, it causes pilling (little white balls)

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] That sunscreen is amazing, lightweight and long lasting and gives a glow. It doesn't leave any white cast easy to absorb and the application is also very smooth. It feels very high and and a little goes a long way.. I would definitely purchase again

I really wanted to like this sunscreen, but it just keeps pilling no matter what I do. I've tried applying it over moisturizer, serums, and even checked ingredients to avoid conflicts it still rubs off every time. Really disappointing.

I wanted to like this sunscreen since it claims to be oil free, and I have really oily skin but I found tha it was way too dry. It clung to any dry patch I had and clumped up. It also left a white cast and made me look 2 shades lighter in the face despite me already being pale!

This powerful chemical SPF 60 sunscreen paired with antioxidants protects your skin from UVA/UBA, rays that can cause sun damage. The hydrating formula is great under makeup or on its own. It also does not leave a white cash or pill.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I live in south Florida and walk a TON. I am always looking for the best sunscreen to protect my skin from damage. The packaging is so nice being as it's not bulky so it's easily stored in a bag. The lotion goes on smooth and absorbs nicely without leaving a greasy film. Does give a nice glow though!
It rubs off and pills no matter how I apply it. I've tried before & after moisturizer, with and without other skincare products. I've tried it on clean, bare skin and it still balls up.

Horrible! I am a black girl and it left me looking like a ghost. I used it on a freshly washed face and it never rubbed in and it also pilled up horribly on my face. Returning immediately. Waste of money.

No matter how much or or little i use, with or without other products, I keep getting this with pellets all over. It does not play well with makeup, so will not apply under. I'll be returning this one

Unfortunately this not only caused extreme breakouts within hours of wearing it but it has a white cast and pills easily. Forget about putting it under makeup. I've never experienced a sunscreen so disappointed as this. My face felt disgusting while wearing this and I because I was in very strong, harsh sun on vacation, I just used a hat and never let my face go uncovered for longer than a few minutes. I was a big waste of money.
would be such a great product if it didn't peel right off my face. I find no matter how little or much I use it will turn white and peel. it also stings really bad if gotten on eyes.

I find that this sunscreen DOES disappear on my skin and doesnt leave whitecast, which i appreciate! However, its really hard to rub in and I can never tell if its even. Also, I absolutely cannot get past the smell. It is like lighter fluid and Ive come to dread using it. Once I'm out of product I do not plan to buy again.

Do not buy this, i tried it once and it started to peel off my skin. I thought maybe it was something in my skincare, I tried it again a second and a third time a few days later with different things incorporated into my skincare routine. It still peeled. The consistency is terrible. This feels more like body sunscreen you use to go to the beach, etc. I would def not wear it under makeup.
This face sunscreen will burn your eyes like no other. I've never had an issue with any other face sunscreen doing this.

This was not one of my fave sunscreens. It was actively drying to my skin, so it was not great under makeup. It also started pilling a lot, as other reviews mention. I tried using more at a time to see if that would help but no luck.

avis.titre: i woud not buy this product again
avis.texte: This product spills on my skin, idk if I am using them in the wrong manner or if there's something wrong with the product. I have oily acne acne-prone skin.
It felt really nice on the skin but it pills like crazy and it also clung to my black heads. Dont buy ut

Think i was sent the sample because its only half way full. Its a nice sunscreen for face but the product is very small for the price you are paying especially if the bottle only gets filled up half way.
This is so awful! It leaves a whitecast. Balled up on my neck. Massively regretting purchasing this and throwing away the box. I'll stick to Banana Boat.

I have oily skin and struggle to find a good moisturizer with SPF that doesn't exacerbate the situation. I was hopeful about this product because I use other La Roche-Posay products and love them. However, this is by far the worst one, I've ever used. The sunscreen immediately pills up and leaves little white balls all over your face. I've tried every combination of applying it, and it doesn't absorb smoothly no matter what. I'm super disappointed. Don't buy this sunscreen!

This spf is too drying. I have to apply moisturizer underneath it to not feel uncomfortably dry, but this spf already doesn't melt into the skin well, so it def doesn't sit on top of other products well. I also find that I can rub my face hours after applying this and product will rub off in chunks. I will not be repurchasing.

I'm confused by some of the negative reviews! This product is great! I asked my Dermatologist what she uses on her kids and she said this product. I have been using it gor years now. It's the only face sunblock I've found tbat feel light enough to wear under makeup. I even sometimes mix in a dab of foundation to make a tinted sunscreen. If you rub it in, it doesnt leave a white sheen (full disclosure, I am a fair, white skin tone that burns/turns pink fairly easily). My teenage daughter loves it because it's the only sunscreen that doesn't make her acne worse.
I gotva sample of this and i used it yesterday. I applied it every 30-45 minutes. My face never went under water. My face is so red and sensitive to touch today. Be careful if you use this product.
It's pills and dried up my skin. I would put my morning skincare then wait 15-20 mins after applying moisturizer and it would still pull.

avis.titre: Perfect for Oily/Acne Prone/ Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I have been using this sunscreen for over a year now and it works great for me. I hate the oily feeling if sunscreen. This one does not feel oily and dries really quick. Although it does peel most if the time, its worth it for me. I havent been able to find a suncsreen that works this good for me. Also its best to make sure you completely moisturize before using the sunscreen. Its less likely to peel!

avis.titre: This stung my eyes after only minutes of sweating
avis.texte: I used this on my beach trip and it stung my eyes. it was hot and muggy out, I was sweating within minutes, and when it got into my eyes it did sting quite a bit. Did keep me from burning, but if you drip sweat, cry, or swim, it stings your eyes.

avis.titre: Leaves a white cast but can be rubbed in
avis.texte: If i didnt have time to wait for this to settle before putting on other skin care or make up, I would not use this on my face. After putting it on and then brushing my hair up into a ponytail I noticed a little bit of streaking along my chin. When I got closer, I noticed my entire face had this white cast on it. I was able to rub it in with my fingers, but I am concerned that this is essentially just put the sunscreen on my hands and not my face. I'll probably use it elsewhere on my body as it does go on very smoothly and does not leave you greasy, no obnoxious smell and doesn't burn the eyes. Feels very moisturizing. I may use this as a hand sunscreen. I wish i could attach a photo because the camera REALLY captured how much was sitting on top of my skin.

This sunscreen works very well, but I turned it into a body sunscreen bc it just doesn't work w my face. I usually put a few layers of skincare over on in the morning, then sunscreen, and when I use this it pills immediately and all day.
This is the only product from this brand that i absolutley hate. I do not have sensitive skin yet it i feel an extreme burning sensation while rubbing it on my face.

This the first time I have to say the negative reviews were right! This product does give the white cast effect. It seems I have rubbed white powder all over my face. I'm just going to use a tiny bit until it runs out. Won't purchase again.
Tried this product bc im an oily skin type. Looking for something that won't clog my pores. Left a heavily noticeable white cast. By the end of the day leaves white residue. Will be returning
I have sensitive skin. This sunscreen stings my eyes and leaves a white cast.

I bought this and had such good hopes for it i threw the pckaging away same day i got it. Ive tried it twice now with 2 different moisturizers and it peels horrible, i struggled to get it off my neck and my hair line. Im not sure if im doing something wrong but if i am why would spf be made so difficult to use. I wish i could return.
I really want to love this one but it leave white cast and piling every time I apply. Look ridiculous when apply and put no makeup after.

this was suggested when looking up possible sunscreens for oily skin. i enjoy the brand for face wash, and moisturizer. i figured i would enjoy the SPF, wrong. now, i have tried it multiple ways. i have tried it with moisturizer first then SPF like normal, it peeled. i tried just using the SPF, and it was hit or miss on whether it would end up peeling or not. sometimes it just left a white cast. at one point i used a little aquaphor and the SPF, that helped with being able to rub it all in, and avoid a white cast. but using the aquaphor ultimately defeated the purpose as i was trying to avoid the extra shine/oil. i tried with my face dry and with my face damp, each still had its issues with sometimes blending in, and sometimes leaving a white cast. some days it did excalty what it was suppsoed to do, and when it worked it did control the oil and give me a more matte finish/feel. i don't absolutely hate it, but i don't love it enough to keep it. i will be returning, and trying a new one.

avis.titre: Pills and hard to rub in
avis.texte: Pills no matter what I do, dries down way too fast even when applying a lot which makes it hard to rub in, leaving a white cast. Not a good every day sunscreen for me.

was looking for a daily facial sunscreen & this missed the mark. I have dry skin & typically apply sunscreen after skincare. This pilled horribly and left a white cast. tried this on my bare skin another day & it was super streaky on my dry/combo skin & still left a white cast. I typically love LRP sunscreen but not this one.

avis.titre: Definitely oil free but so hard to apply
avis.texte: I have oily skin so im always looking for sunscreen moisturizers like these, but it pills so bad trying to put it on. If u put moisturizer on top of it, you can rub it in better. But rubbing in all the white and trying to eliminate all the pilling on my face makes it lowkey not worth it. But if you really need dry oil free, i think you can nake it work.

I burn easily; without sun protection, I can burn in as little as 20 minutes. I spend more time outside than I do inside and I need excellent sun block as well as other protection like hats and clothing. I've tried just about every sunscreen out there, and Anthelios is far superior. It stops sun damage for about 2 hours for me, and when worn with a sun hat, I can be outside for hours without burning. Even in the desert, where the sun reflects off the sand back upwards, this protected me. This face sunscreen is as advertised - clear, doesn't leave residue, and keeps my face protected from sun damage. It doesn't block my pores or cause any skin irritation. Love it!

I decided to try a new sunscreen and this one caught my eye, mostly because its supposed to be matte which for the most part, is. It dries down quickly and absorbs well. My only downside is that no matter how much I rub into my skin, it leaves a white cast. I have a light/olive skintone for reference. Ill stick to my LRP double moisturizer with SPF 30.

I recently tried this sunscreen that was quite disappointing. First off, it felt extremely dry on my skin, making it uncomfortable to wear for extended periods. The worst part was the noticeable white cast it left behind, which made my complexion look uneven and ashy. To add to the frustration, it started peeling off throughout the day, creating an unsightly mess on my face. Overall, I wouldn't recommend this sunscreen if you're looking for something that feels moisturizing and blends well without leaving any residue and peel off .
The only chemical suncreen I've owned that leaves a white cast. Truly horrendous. Will use it up under my clothing on days when I'm outside as it is water resistant.

I have very oily skin and was recommended this subscreen to help control it. At first, it did control my oil throughout the day, however after continued use it started to pill horribly. It must be applied with some technique if not, the pills will be all over your face. I have to rub off the excess sunscreen from my hands after applying as well. If you leave it on without blending fast enough it starts to pill and if you rub it in too much it also pills. Honestly the benefits are not worth it for me.
This sunscreen doesn't absorb well and leaves a major white cast.
it left my skin matte but could not blend it properly without it balling up on my skin. Very dissatisfied.
This pills like crazy on top of any moisturizer, including La Roche Posay. I've tried it a million ways — what a waste.

I've been using this sunscreen for about a year now and absolutely love it. I personally find it works really well with my semi-oily skin. Can't say how it works under makeup since I don't wear makeup anymore. How I apply it for best results is to put about a dime size amount on one finger, then take about half onto a finger on my other hand and then dot it around my face. After that, I smooth it all out and make sure it absorbs. I really hope they keep making this specific sunscreen for a long time because I haven't found anything else that works well for me.

I've tired this product alone with no other products. Also tried with moisturizer, eye creams, etc. It starts to ball up and separate the moment you put it in your skin! LOVE the milk sunscreen. I originally thought that was what I ordered, but I picked the wrong one. Decided to test this one out. Wrong! Don't recommend. Very clumpy. I cant even use it and that makes me sad.

avis.titre: Good for extremely oily, not for me
avis.texte: As an esthetician, I am very picky about sunscreens. I have regular skin that can occassionally be oily and I hate the feeling of heavy slimey sunscreens in the heat. This one was extremely mattifying to the point of feeling powdery. Personally I found it drying for me. My face was left tight, however for someone with extreme oil prone skin this would be great. Be aware it dries very quickly and you will have to blend like your life depends on it. I found creasing in my eyelid area, however I always apply quite generously for good coverage.
I have sensitive skin and this sunscreen burns horrible.... also I can't handle the white cast ... don't buy it 😩

Absolute trash spf, do not buy. Worst spf possible, takes forever to set even after blending 4 times. White cast like crazy and pills, little protection against the sun. Burns eyes really bad and causes acne.

Absolute trash spf, do not buy. Worst spf possible, takes forever to set even after blending 4 times. White cast like crazy and pills, little protection against the sun. Burns eyes really bad and causes acne.

Absolute trash spf, do not buy. Worst spf possible, takes forever to set even after blending 4 times. White cast like crazy and pills, little protection against the sun. Burns eyes really bad and causes acne.

I needed a good sunscreen for a Florida trip. Had fairly clear skin but as the trip progressed I noticed more and more clogged pores and blackheads. The only difference was this sunscreen. It also has a white cat no matter how much I rubbed it in. And it burned my face when applied.

avis.titre: Made me break out into a rash
avis.texte: I wanted to like it, and I love their facial lotions, but as someone with sensitive skin this made me break out in a rash around my nose and the lower half of my face. I have no clue why, but it did not work for me.
I usually love all the sunscreens from this brand. But this one leaves a white cast.
I applied this as my last step....it left a white cast. I've never had this happen.

avis.titre: Good spf, leaves white clumps all over my face
avis.texte: This sunscreen pills on my skin more than anything ive ever tried. Bad for everyday. Don't even think about trying to wear it under makeup

avis.titre: Does not work with other products
avis.texte: This sunscreen pills when I do my skincare routine. I use a toner, serum, moisturizer, and (this) sunscreen. And I make sure to thoroughly apply on my face with my clean hands, massaging like a mini lymphatic massage. I notice as I'm massaging the sunscreen pills into little white balls. I also made sure to put a small amount of moisturizer and it still happened.

I don't know if they changed the formula of this sunscreen as I've used it before with no issues. This time around the sunscreen migrates into my eyes without me even sweating and burns like crazy. Shame because I normally love La Roche Posay's sunscreens.

This is the best susncreen I've used on my oily skin. It gives a velvet finish on your screen, which I love!! I've tried different sunscreen recommended for oily skin but always ended up looking like a pastelito. This is the only one I've liked so far!

When I first got this sunscreen I got a terrible white cast and pilling on my face and arms. But a couple of months later I tried using a different way on applying this sunscreen. Instead of applying it with my skin being dry, I tried moisturizing the skin with a lotion/moisturizer first before applying and that seems to help it not give a white cast or pilling. Though it does have a typical sunscreen smell which I personally dont mind as the smell goes away quickly. In general I reccomend this sunscreen but I advise that it is a bit tricky to understand in terms of how to not get pilling or a white cast.

A little goes a long way. Spreads easily, blends well. I have combo skin, and this doubles as my moisturizer. If I put on moisturizer prior to applying this, my skin gets super oily. It does not break me out, so that's a plus. It's pricey, so I would love to find a cheaper alternative.

I have such an oily T-zone, but this sunscreen almost makes it disappear completely! There is absolutely NO whitecast and it feels SO lightweight, which is what I was looking for in a daily sunscreen!
i havent even worn it with makeup bc it leaves such a strong white cast

Do not like this sunscreen. It leaves white cast in certain areas of face and pills often. Sometimes it pills inmediately and other time it'll pill after a 2 hours of wear. I definitely do not use this under makeup application because it will pill your makeup and leave an unclean application of makeup.

avis.titre: dries quickly but i use two fingers length of product
avis.texte: leaves white cast especially on eyebrows, i like how its not greasy and i try to not get it in my eye bc it does burn but the cera ve tinted one doesnt burn i think ill go back to that one

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: A mat finish but it does not blend in well. Makes my makeup flake off and rolls of my skin. Kind of embarrassing walking around with white splotches and people asking if you left your skin like that on purpose. A waste of money

avis.titre: Listen to the Reviews - Do Not Buy !
avis.texte: i needed a new sunscreen and figured i'd give this one a try. i read the reviews and saw some mentioning it causing their skin to break out, but thought that can happen with any product, not everyone's skin will react the same to products right ? dear lord no. after only two uses my entire face is breaking out in a rash and white heads everywhere. i returned it immediately. save your self and DO NOT BUY THIS

avis.titre: I wanted to like it so bad...
avis.texte: I liked their Toleriane Double Repair Face Moisturizer UV SPF 30 but I have oily skin and it made me terribly greasy. This one was suggested for oily skin so I was looking forward to trying it but pilled and hurt to rub in to my face with my acne.

High SPF and not greasy but i did not enjoy the formula of this because of the white cast it leaves behind and the pilling. i cannot put makeup over it or even touch my face after because of the pilling — and the white cast is awful
I went for a facial and the lady recommended I use this SPF. One of the worst I've ever tried. Leaves a white cast and pills IMMEDIATELY with our without any skincare under it.
This always pills up when i rub it in too much, which always happens because if i dont rub it in super well it leaves a white cast. Its fine, but i prefer the one by Neutrogena which is cheaper

Skin type- super sensitive, acne prone I've tried quite a few sunscreens- hero's mineral sunscreen, eucerin, black girl sunscreen, australian gold, good molecules, and lots more. Those are great, but all occasionally broke me out. I'm on trentinion, and with this sunscreen, I feel protected and I don't feel like it's counterproductive to the retinoid's work on my skin. I've used it for a month now and it's yet to break me out. It leaves the sheerest cast, but hardly noticeable, especially if you wear a touch of any other product really. Will definitely repurchase. A skin safe win!

avis.titre: Great for not looking greasy, not great for everything else
avis.texte: Ive been on the hunt for a sunscreen that doesnt look greasy and oily, i have very oily skin. First i tried their ultra light spf and that one was ok but after a while id get sooo shiny. With the dry touch it does keep my dry but with an emphasis of the dry. It feels awful on my hands and settles into the lines on my faces and wrinkles on my neck.

Ulta was out of my usual La Roche-Posay facial sunscreen so I thought I'd try this one. Definitely not the same. I did not like this product. Left a horrible white cast and would also pill and leave white specs (like white paint specs almost) if you so as much lightly itched or touched your face. I don't know why it left a white cast as it's not a mineral sunscreen. Either way, the product was returned and I was able to pick up my usual product. This one was not for me.
I cant even spread it onto my face without it pilling. Whether I use a lot, a little, mix up my skincare routine, nothing works- it just pills and comes right off. Also, it smells like sulfur.

I never make reviews about any product, but theres a first time for everything, I guess. I didnt feel any burning, but when I took my make up off and washed my face, my forehead, cheekbone area, bridge of nose, and a bit of my neck broke out. Now I'm annoyed because I dont know how long my skin will take to clear. Ive used Neutrogena sunscreen for years and I'll just resort to using that again. Horrible product, and it says "doesn't cause breakouts" LOL ok

avis.titre: Amazing product! I would absolutely buy this again!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a while now and absolutely love it! I have super sensitive skin and everything makes me break out. This is one of the few products I have ever tried that I have never had an issue with.
It did spread white but did not last long through sweat. Not worth it for me.
It's made specifically for face, so it shouldn't burn when you sweat right? WRONG. Literally the most eye burning, itching and water face sunscreen I have ever used.

I never ever write reviews but this sunscreen is horrible. My skin can take just about any product and I never have any reactions however this sunscreen felt like something was literally burning my skin. Would not recommend.

This sunscreen is way too expensive for it to be pilling as much as it does. You rub it in a little and it pills, but you have to rub it in for it to not leave a terrible white cast. I would not recommend, there are many more sunscreens at this price point, and below, that perform way better than thjs one.

Was looking for a new sunscreenso gave this one a try its an okay sunscreen but make sure its all blended or you'll see sunscreen streaks, also it would leave white residue around my hairline and it would leave white residue on my eyebrows when i would gel them down. It also caused me to break out a little more surprisingly since its made for acne-prone skin

After reading all of the reviews about it pilling, I'm happy to say that mine didn't pill while applying. If I started rubbing my face more afterwards I notice it starts to get weird, but not noticeable. THE WHITE CAST THOUGH, why is no one talking about the white cast? It's definitely noticeable. I haven't tried wearing this with make up yet so I'm not sure how they work together. I'll use up what I have for no make up days but I won't be buying again, the whitecast is too much for me.

This sunscreen leaves white streaks that show up ~1 hour after applying the product no matter how much you blend. If you try to blend it again later, it pills off. Would not recommend but at least it didn't make me break out.

Very lightweight. Reapplication didn't make it feel oily. After a long day at the beach my skin felt great and as someone with sensitive skin my skin was very soft and normal. Did not clog pores. Would recommend!

I never use sunscreen and since I'm trying to take more care of my skin I bought this sunscreen because of recommendations and some of the good reviews I saw. The sunscreen was easy to apply and blend but as soon as I stepped outside and the sun hit my face my eyes started to get a burning sensation and watery. I seriously thought I had gotten something in my eye but no the irritation kept on going until I washed my face it never crossed my mind that maybe it was the sunscreen but the next day my eyes were fine and again I tried the sunscreen and again the same thing happened. Third day I didn't apply it and did my normal routine and I was perfectly fine no burning sensation on my eyes. One of the chemicals in the sunscreen might not be suitable for all people faces. I really wanted to love this sunscreen because of all the hype it has but no👎🏼
The only pros are that is does the job and is acne friendly. But as many others have said, it pills, flakes, collects in the eyebrows and hairline, and clings to dry patches.

I never write reviews, but after trying for weeks to use this product I felt compelled to write a review. With the amount of sunscreens on the market, if you are on the fence about trying this product, SKIP. It pills on the face TREMENDOUSLY. No matter how many times or different ways I try to apply this product, it pills and does not blend into the skin.
